notes: Sagaing Division Kathè Males printed with a broken first digit ('6(8'); read as 668 = sum of districts. In the Chin columns (10-13) for Sagaing districts the figures sit progressively lower than their row labels; assigned by counting entries (e.g. Other Chin dialects M 4 / F 1 = Lower Chindwin) and confirmed by the division sums. No row labels on leaf 239; this leaf has the District or State column. Part I-E Distribution of Selected Languages by Districts, leaves 238-239 (printed pages 232-233); same 51 rows as Part I-D. Self-checks: every division/total row = sum of its parts (all pass); and A-1 + A-2/3 + other Burma = I-D Burma Group, C-1 + C-45 + other Chin = I-D Kuki-Chin Group, I-1 + other Tai = I-D Tai (Shan) Group, N-1 + N-2 + N-9 + other Karen = I-D Karen Group, for every row (all pass).
